about: WO-035: the interview patterns of the 50 firms the mock covers. A firm with a full company record (packages/career-data/cirs) takes its patterns from that record; the 17 firms without one carry their own here. Every pattern and every firm question cites a public URL with its source type (official, posting, reported, anecdotal) and the date it was checked. A question is listed under a firm only when a source attributes that question to that firm; nothing here claims when a firm last asked anything. Questions that cannot be sourced to a firm stay in the role banks (packages/career-data/interview-banks).
list_basis: ASSUMED: the 50 are the 33 companies with a full record plus 17 large employers in the same four groups (banks, consulting, big tech, quant) chosen by the builder; the owner has not named the 50 (WO-025).
method: Checked by web search on the dates given; the build sandbox could not open firm pages directly, so each pattern restates the search result's summary of the cited page. Open the URL before quoting a pattern as the firm's words.

patterns.text: Accenture's careers blog says the behavioral interview evaluates how you manage and overcome challenging situations, and suggests answering with the situation, the actions you took and the result.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Its example topics: managing a challenging project, adopting a new system or way of working, working with a difficult colleague or client, learning and applying a new skill, resolving a conflict, and handling a stressful period.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: Topics, not verbatim questions: the post's exact wording was not copied.

patterns.text: Apple's process is decentralized: what follows the recruiter call varies by team, and the job description hints at what each interview loop will emphasize.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Guides list a recruiter screen, a technical or role-specific phone interview, a take-home assessment for some roles, and an onsite or virtual loop that for engineers covers coding, system design and behavioral questions.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Candidate guides describe a recorded HireVue video interview of behavioral questions, with a short time to prepare each answer, before the superday.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: The superday is reported as a mix of technical and behavioral interviews.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: For programmes without technical requirements, candidates may be invited to a recorded video interview of three to five questions; the assessment centre has two or three stages, including a motivational interview with a member of the leadership team.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: Bright Network employer-advice page about Barclays (UK programmes).

patterns.text: Candidate reports describe a first round and then a superday that mixes behavioral interviews, finance technicals, situational questions, and brain teasers or case questions.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Reported technical questions include a paper LBO and a merger model with stock and cash consideration.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: A Citadel-hosted 2022 article describes the internship interviews as a phone screen followed by four on-site interviews, with traders, quantitative researchers and software engineers interviewing, and values assessed alongside technical ability.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: Article dated 2022; covers Citadel and Citadel Securities internships. Citadel Securities has its own record.

patterns.text: Citi's campus recruiters advise matching your past experience to the competencies in the job description, preparing for technical questions, and having a clear answer to why Citi and why that business line.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: Summarized across Citi's recruiter interview-advice pages for students; open the page to see which recruiter gives which tip.

patterns.text: A university careers page on Citi says the first-round interview covers behavioral and technical questions, and the superday has several individual and group activities that test critical and lateral thinking.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: University of Queensland page about Citi Australia.

firms.name: Goldman Sachs — Investment Banking (Global Banking & Markets)

patterns.text: IMC's recruitment page says interns and graduates need no specific industry experience; it looks for a general interest in financial markets and a strong analytical or technical background, and advises researching IMC's culture and preparing technical concepts.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Technical rounds with traders are reported to involve mental math, probability, and market-making or betting games.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Kearney's cases are reported as candidate-led, like BCG and Bain cases, and some offices also give a written case or an Excel test.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: The first technical screen is a coding interview with a Meta engineer that decides whether you go on to the full loop: one or two problems on data structures and algorithms in a shared online editor, and you are expected to say what you are thinking as you work.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: Meta Careers blog post dated 2022-10-06; the format may have changed since.

patterns.text: A typical software engineering loop is reported as two coding interviews, a system design interview for mid-level and senior engineers, and a behavioral interview.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Moelis runs global Analyst and Associate programs and offers students a series of virtual recruiting events to prepare for investment banking interviews.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Guides describe an online assessment, a first round of one or two interviews with an analyst or associate focused mostly on technicals, then a superday of back-to-back interviews with bankers.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Guides describe a recruiter call, a hiring manager screen, a technical phone interview and an onsite loop, with heavy weight on Netflix's culture and values; candidates are told to be ready to discuss the culture memo.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: NVIDIA's hiring page says interviews are with the hiring manager and team members by phone, video or in person, and that you complete an onsite, in-person interview at an office before you can be considered for an offer.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: The interview has two main parts, a behavioral interview and a case interview; cases are built on business problems the firm has helped clients with, across sectors such as finance, health, energy, retail and transportation.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Optiver's US campus FAQ says the process starts with an online assessment followed by behavioral and technical interviews, that final rounds are virtual, and that it assesses quick decision-making and composure under pressure; mental math is necessary but not sufficient.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: Salesforce's university recruiting guide tells candidates to review the company's values and products before the interview, and to use Trailhead, starting with the Rock Your Future With Salesforce trail.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: For sales roles, Salesforce's own Trailhead module describes a panel interview and a sales presentation.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox

patterns.text: SIG's campus postings list the steps: application, an online assessment of quantitative and problem-solving skills, behavioral and technical phone interviews, and an office interview with a trader interview and a trade floor visit.
patterns.basis: web search result summary; the page itself was not opened from the build sandbox
patterns.note: SIG's Graduate Quantitative Trader 2026 posting as listed on MIT's career site.
